rollback.cmd:
labels=$(oc get node crc -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels}') || exit 1
if grep -q '"lab-pool"' <<<"$labels"; then oc label node crc lab-pool-; fi

verify.cmd:
found=$(oc get namespace lab-payments --ignore-not-found -o name) || exit 1
test -z "$found"

labels=$(oc get node crc -o jsonpath='{.metadata.labels}') || exit 1
! grep -q '"lab-pool"' <<<"$labels"
